statement: Fix a,b>=1 with 3^a>2^(a+b), an integer modulus M>=1, and B. Infinitely many actual Juggler starts n>B follow O^a E^b, stay at least n throughout that prefix, and have J^(a+b)(n)>n with both endpoints congruent to 1 modulo 2M. Construction: s=1+2Mt, n=s^(2^(a-1)); the first a-1 odd steps are exact powers and subsequent roots are floor(s^(3^a/2^(j+1))). Joint equidistribution of the b+1 distinct nonintegral powers, by Weyl and Boshernitzan's classical Hardy-field criterion, gives a successful parameter set of asymptotic density 1/(2^(b+1)M). The periodic code of O^a E^b has denominator q=(3^a-2^(a+b))/gcd(3^a-2^a,2^b-1), unbounded as a grows at fixed b, and M may be any fixed power of q. Hence arbitrary prescribed congruence-return precision does not force ordinary integrality of the rational cycle code. This does not concern true endpoint equality or establish witnesses within a cycle's finance window.
